description: Header file defining multi-dimensional tensor data structures with static and dynamic implementations, including interfaces for resizing, viewing, and accessing tensor elements.

classes.name: tensor
classes.description: Base interface for multi-dimensional tensors supporting views and element access.

classes.name: static_tensor
classes.description: Tensor implementation with fixed maximum size, resizable up to a limit.

classes.name: dynamic_tensor
classes.description: Tensor implementation with dynamically resizable storage.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Returns a view of the tensor data along specified dimensions.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses tensor elements via multi-dimensional indices.

methods.name: get_dimensions_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each tensor dimension.

methods.name: get_dimension_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific tensor dimension.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the tensor to specified dimensions.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves memory for the tensor in dynamic implementation.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns total number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is empty.
